notes.title: REC
notes.text: REC: on TRACKS a REC tap arms / disarms the selected track, saying so (T3 REC ARMED / T3 REC OFF). On every other page a REC tap is REC ALL: every track armed (REC ALL, the REC LED and the SMC-Mixer's REC 1-8 lit), so each white track key plays and records its own track wherever the keys play tracks (HOME, SOUND, FX, TRACKS ...): finger-drum a whole kit live. KEYS, step record and knob motion stay the selected track's. A REC tap off TRACKS ends it and arms again the tracks armed before (T3 REC ARMED / REC OFF); on TRACKS it ends it with the selected track armed. Step record on STEP, REC held and STOP TO EDIT while a song plays are unchanged; a learned REC and the SMC-Mixer's REC act as the button on the page shown; the SMC-Mixer's REC n during REC ALL ends it and disarms track n (the others stay armed). Not saved in projects, as the arm state.

notes.title: REC no longer starts play
notes.text: REC no longer starts play: a REC tap (and REC ALL, a learned REC, the SMC-Mixer's REC and REC 1-8) only arms / disarms; PLAY starts the transport, and an armed track records once playing. Step record is unchanged.
